compile.connector_rule: Insert one geometry-only midpoint only when adjacent authored keys have identical support_contact, contact_state, and drag_surface_state; otherwise hard cut. Connector inherits no new semantic state and cannot invent support/contact/root/drag state.
compile.method: AUTHORED ASCII KEYS -> EXPLICIT HOLDS/TIMING -> DETERMINISTIC CONNECTIVE MOTION -> ASCII-ONLY FRAME RENDER -> MP4 -> SPA
compile.renderer: Python/Pillow renders literal ASCII rig frames; ffmpeg libx264 yuv420p

The generic contact/compression/rebound/return sequence is an independent landing abstraction; the source sheet does not provide reliable source-authentic landing timing.
Every decisive timing class uses PoseLab V1 STREET_FIGHTER/CAPCOM because source timing was not measured.

The sheet visibly contains grounded/non-airborne soldier states, compact and extended airborne soldier silhouettes, and long bands with an external parachute/canopy above the figure.
The source page independently labels Fall, Jump, Parachute, and Soldier descends by parachute animation families.

The static sheet does not establish source-authentic exposure duration, world-space root positions, or exact gameplay transition order.
